title: [ingest] Native task IDs are session-local; cross-session refs MUST be namespaced session-uuid/id
summary: Native task IDs ('1','2',…) are unique only within one session and sessions in a workspace don't see each other's native tasks. Any cross-session dependency edge must use {session-uuid}/{id}. This is the core reason the overlay store exists — native tasks structurally cannot hold cross-session edges.
